title: New Hermitage
visualBrief: New Hermitage exterior: exact irregular main outline, two enclosed courtyards and open northern recess, three independently mapped raised halls/end pavilions, cream two-storey classical facades/upper pavilion tiers, green faceted metal roofs, framed upper windows/pilasters/cornices and neutral relief-panel masses. Entrance portico follows the native slanted southern frontage, with ten original faceted Atlas figures/posed arms and legs supporting the lintel, bounded podium/steps/side ramp, balcony rail and simple timber doors. Replace only the parent and three integrated building parts. Small/Old Hermitage/Theatre, their connecting galleries, independent buildings/roads/canal/water remain native. No furnished collections, copied sculpture/reliefs/lettering or exact ornamental inventory.
